info.title: NextBookstore API
info.description: REST API of the bookstore. Prices are in dollars with two decimals. Errors always have the shape { error, code }. Authentication uses NextAuth session cookies: GET /api/auth/csrf, then POST /api/auth/callback/credentials (form fields csrfToken, email, password, json=true). The guest cart uses the bookstore_session_id cookie.

get.summary: Admin: the whole catalog as a CSV download
get.description: Columns: id, isbn, title, author, price, stock, categories (names separated by |), description. Cells that start with = + - @ are prefixed with an apostrophe so spreadsheets do not run them.

post.summary: Admin: add or update books from CSV text. Books are matched by ISBN.
post.description: Send the CSV as the request body (Content-Type text/csv, at most 1 MB and 1000 books). Required columns: title, author, price, stock. Optional: isbn, categories (names separated by |, missing ones are created; an empty cell keeps the current categories of the book), description; id is ignored. The import is all or nothing: if any row is invalid the answer is 400 CSV_INVALID with `details.errors` (row number and message) and nothing changes. Use dryRun=true to check without saving.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: For example BOOK_PRICE_CHANGED, BOOK_STOCK_CHANGED, ORDER_STATUS_CHANGED, USER_ROLE_CHANGED

post.summary: Pay for the signed-in user cart and turn it into an order (status CONFIRMED), reduce stock and count the promo code
post.description: Signing in is required. Prices are recomputed on the server; the client never sends amounts. The payment provider is a mock; the card number decides the outcome: 4242424242424242 succeeds, 4000000000000002 is declined, 4000000000009995 has insufficient funds, 4000000000000119 gives a processing error, 4000000000000341 times out. Card numbers and security codes are never stored. If the order cannot be completed after the charge, the charge is refunded.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR (including a card number that fails the check or an expired card), ORDER_REJECTED (empty cart, missing book, not enough stock), INVALID_PROMO, PROMO_EXPIRED or PROMO_EXHAUSTED

402.description: Payment failed, nothing was charged and the cart is kept: CARD_DECLINED, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, PROCESSING_ERROR or PAYMENT_TIMEOUT

403.description: EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: confirm the email address first

post.description: Standard shipping is free from 50.00 after discount; Express is never free. Tax is charged on the discounted subtotal.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR, ORDER_REJECTED (empty cart), INVALID_PROMO, PROMO_EXPIRED or PROMO_EXHAUSTED

post.description: Allowed while the status is PENDING or CONFIRMED. Puts the books back in stock and refunds the payment.

400.description: Validation failed (code VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_JSON or INVALID_ID)

post.summary: Admin: move the order to the next fulfilment step (Pending, Confirmed, Shipped, Delivered)

409.description: INVALID_TRANSITION (the order is Delivered, Cancelled or Returned)

post.summary: Return a delivered order and get the full payment back. Owner only; another user's order answers 404.
post.description: Allowed for 30 days after delivery. Puts the books back in stock, refunds the payment and sets the status to RETURNED. The reason is optional and shown in the status history.

400.description: Validation failed (code VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_JSON or INVALID_ID)

409.description: INVALID_TRANSITION (not delivered) or RETURN_WINDOW_CLOSED (more than 30 days after delivery)

get.description: Available for orders that were paid. A refunded order still has its invoice, marked Refunded.

400.description: Validation failed (code VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_JSON or INVALID_ID)

409.description: NOT_PAID (no payment was taken for this order)
